newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends lightly-traded session higher.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends lightly-traded session higher.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed with modest gains which traders largely attributed to short covering.
In addition, General Mills was featured buying the December/March spread at about 16-1/2 cents per bushel premium December, sources said. The spread closed at 17 cents.
Volume was light and several traders said futures moved higher when early selling failed to press prices lower.

Planting progress data released late Monday was considered bearish but failed to prompt strong selling. USDA reported 54 percent of the U.S. winter wheat had been seeded as of Sunday up from 33 percent a week earlier.
KCBT wheat closed up 6-1/4 to 2-1/2 cents a bushel with December up the most at $4.41-1/2 per bushel.
